transcriber_notes: Avanet PDF wrapping a raster chart; measured on the embedded image (6160x2832, 24.77 px/cm). Boundaries printed on the right axis (99, 88, 75, 74, 40, 36, 35, 10, 8, 0) and agree with bar edges (74, 35, 8 labels offset by slanted leaders). Hardness from bar ends on the I/K/P/1F/4F/F grid (708/968/1228/1488/1748/2008 px; thirds as +/-): 1316 px (two-thirds from 1F toward P) -> P-. Grain column holds only '=' (IFrc per guide) in the three 1-2 cm K layers and □ at 40-36; sizes and water content blank throughout. Temperature is a red line without point markers: break points 89, 79, 69, 49, 39, 9 cm (i.e. every 10 cm of depth) and ends 99/0 cm (0 C at 2113.6 px, 46.3 px/C; the dashed air line reaches -9.5 C at the top, matching the header; values land on 0.5 C steps).
